name: bada-asobi
description: Bada Asobi — a quantum 'play' runtime for the Bada language. Play is defined as the amplitude a system keeps outside its own rule eigenstate; the thought of a violation is the partial rotation exp(-i*theta*V/2) generated by an operator V anticommuting with the rule's stabilizer, bounded so that a thought never reaches the act at theta = pi. Inside that magic circle, the individual mutation algorithm of a genetic algorithm is rebuilt as transgressive-thought mutation: minimal violation generators that break exactly one norm while preserving every other rule and all inviolable ones. Self-contained HTML app.
author: Masaaki Yamaguchi
